{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Verify premises
assert 'severe' in df['severity'].unique(), "Severity 'severe' not found in data"
assert len(df[df['severity'] == 'severe']) > 0, "No patients with severe disease found in the trial"

# Remove sentinel values (-999) in biomarker_baseline
df_clean = df[df['biomarker_baseline'] != -999]

# Deduplicate: keep highest sample_seq per patient_id
df_dedup = df_clean.sort_values('sample_seq', ascending=False).drop_duplicates(subset='patient_id', keep='first')

# Filter for severe disease
severe_only = df_dedup[df_dedup['severity'] == 'severe']

# Compute mean baseline biomarker
count_severe = len(severe_only)
mean_baseline_severe = severe_only['biomarker_baseline'].mean()

print(f"Number of severe patients after deduplication: {count_severe}")
print(f"Mean baseline biomarker (ng/mL) for severe patients: {mean_baseline_severe}")

# Return values for reporting
mean_baseline_severe"}
